name: @monad/publication-site
description: The documentation and engineering-log publication site for Monad.

scripts.build: bun run content:sync && bun --bun next build
scripts.typecheck: bun run content:sync && bun run typegen && tsc --noEmit
scripts.verify: bun run content:validate && bun run check && bun run typecheck && bun run test:unit && bun run build
scripts.verify:strict: bun run content:validate:strict && bun run check && bun run typecheck && bun run test:unit && bun run build
scripts.verify:full: bun run verify && bun run test:e2e
scripts.verify:visual: bun run verify && bun run test:visual
scripts.publication:plan: bun run content:sync && bun run content:report:editions
scripts.publication:build: bun run build && bun run scripts/publications/build.mjs
scripts.publication:pdf: bun run build && bun run scripts/publications/build.mjs --formats pdf
scripts.publication:epub: bun run build && bun run scripts/publications/build.mjs --formats epub
scripts.publication:offline: bun run build && bun run scripts/publications/build.mjs --formats offline,source
scripts.publication:source: bun run content:sync && bun run scripts/publications/build.mjs --formats source
scripts.verify:ci: bun run content:validate && bun run check && bun run typecheck && bun run test:coverage && bun run build
scripts.verify:operations: bun run build && bun run operations:links && bun run operations:security
scripts.verify:release: bun run verify:ci && bun run verify:operations
scripts.release:plan: bun run content:sync && bun run scripts/operations/release-plan.mjs
